faq_q1: How to add a stamp to a customer?
faq_a1: Go to "Cashier Scanner", scan the customer loyalty QR code on their phone (or enter their secret code), then click "+1 Stamp".
faq_q2: How to print my table stands?
faq_a2: In the "QR Generator" tab, customize colors and logo, then click "Download Table Stand PNG (High Resolution)" to print in A5 or A6.
faq_q3: How to update prices or dishes in my menu?
faq_a3: In "Menu Editor", you can add, edit or disable dishes in real-time. Changes are immediately visible to your customers without reprinting QR codes.
faq_q4: Do my customers need to install an app?
faq_a4: No! MenuFid works directly in any mobile browser. Customers can also install the card in 1 click on their home screen via PWA technology.
